title: Death on a Platter by Elaine Viets
description:
Novels & Nibbles pick for this week is a cozy, lighthearted mystery about a mystery shopper Josie Marcus who joins a St Louis food tour. A murder turns a delicious outing into a deadly investigation after someone is poisoned after eating toasted ravioli. With restaurant rivalries, local cuisine, and plenty of twists, Josie must uncover the killer before another course is served.

Unlike the ravioli in the book ours is guaranteed to be poison-free. Our Golden “toasted” cheese ravioli is made-from-scratch and stuffed with Parmesan, provolone, mozzarella, ricotta, and fresh garden basil, “toasted” until golden and crispy, topped with fresh parsley and served with our own marinara sauce.

The only thing deadly about this ravioli is how quickly it disappears from the plate! Come by & Try.
